mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 3-month moving average compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy accommodates economic growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS decline periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) from their 3-month moving averages indicate contraction in the housing sector, reducing consumer spending and business investment, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline from 3-month MA
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both decline from 3-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing slowdown regimes (INDPRO below 100), reduced industrial output signals weakening corporate production and profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days due to earnings pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 0.5% in a 1-month window, it triggers aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real GDP (GDPC1) above its 12-month average indicates robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings and equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 12-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment (UNRATE) above 3.5% and decline in employment (PAYEMS) from its 3-month moving average signals severe labor market contraction, reducing consumer income and spending, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 3.5% and PAYEMS decline from 3-month MA
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 3.5% and PAYEMS decline from 3-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL above 280), central bank rate hikes to combat inflation increase discount rates and reduce risk appetite, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 280.
